caption: The drawing depicts a chicken figure, standing on top of a half-cylinder base. The chicken is rendered in brown tones with detailed feather patterns on its body, which are made up of darker and lighter shades of brown and hints of yellow. Its comb and wattle are red, the beak is a light orange, and the eye is round with a yellow outline and a dark center. The half-cylinder base below the chicken is colored to resemble wood, with visible grain patterns in various shades of brown. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the main objects.
title: Carved Bird
